title: Evolution Companions — Complete 8-Plush Collector Set
descriptionHtml:
All eight soft companions, together in one complete collector set.

Evolution Companions brings the full color lineup home at once: eight small brown plush toys, each dressed in its own removable-looking elemental hood and cape costume.

What is included

  • Eight individual plush toys
  • One pink-and-white ribbon costume
  • One lavender gem-eared costume
  • One icy pale-blue finned costume
  • One bright-blue aquatic costume
  • One orange flame costume
  • One yellow lightning costume
  • One warm golden leaf costume
  • One black moon-ring costume

Materials and care

  • Soft cotton-textile exterior
  • PP cotton filling
  • Embroidered facial details
  • Spot clean gently and air dry

The full set is direct-shipped and may arrive separately from other items in your order. Tracking is provided after dispatch. Transit can take longer around holidays. Small differences in stitching, embroidery placement, color, and finish are normal for soft plush goods. Not suitable for children under 3 years old.

Returns

If your order is lost in transit, arrives damaged or defective, contains the wrong item, or is materially different from its description, contact us with your order number and available photos. View the full policy.
